01.title: Pomodoro Technique
01.description: Study for 25 minutes, then rest for 5. After four rounds take a long break. Keeps your mind sharp and prevents burnout.

02.title: Active Recall
02.description: After reading a unit, close your notes and write down everything you remember. Retrieval practice is far more effective than re-reading.

03.title: Past Papers First
03.description: Attempt past papers early to understand the exam format. Identify your weak areas and redirect your study time there.

04.title: Mind Maps
04.description: Draw visual maps connecting key concepts. Especially effective for Engineering Technology and Science units with many interconnected ideas.

05.title: Teach Someone
05.description: Explain a concept aloud to a friend or even to yourself. The Feynman Technique reveals gaps in your understanding instantly.

06.title: Sleep & Review
06.description: Review your notes just before sleep. Your brain consolidates memories during sleep — take advantage of this biological superpower.
